G-BOOK mX System
By using the customer's Bluetooth compatible cellular phone, "G-BOOK mX", a next-generation telematics service combining the G-BOOK network and the latest technology, can be used.
When using a cellular phone, the service can be used by setting up the cellular phone with the on-board unit and then performing the start-of-use operation; however, some services require Web registration on the PC site G-BOOK.com.
"Map On Demand", which can update new map information in real time using a cellular phone, has been adopted.
By using probe communication traffic information, in which the G-BOOK Center collects the driving information of G-BOOK users, route guidance that takes into account traffic conditions on roads not covered by VICS, "G Route Search (with probe information)", is now possible.
HELPNET, an emergency notification system in which the connection is made manually through screen operation, has been adopted.
"Capsules", multi-song packs, have been provided for G-SOUND, which allows high-quality songs to be enjoyed by downloading encryption keys under the digital rights management system (G-DRM: Digital Rights Management) that stores and manages encrypted music data on the HDD. In particular, approximately 140 songs such as classical music can be used free of charge.
Check the G-BOOK site for cellular phone models whose operation has been confirmed.
To use HELPNET, after Web registration, it is necessary to complete the G-BOOK online service start-of-use and HELPNET service start-of-use operations on the on-board unit.
